description:
Problem: Idle Codex chat repeatedly wakes with 'SAAM: file changed' while Studio is untouched.
Cause: Runtime restoreStudios emits print-opened with restored:true; studioWakeEvent treats every print-opened as a changed selection, including restoration of the same bundle/version.
Evidence: Repeated events retain Studio a2d01d90 and selection def3a9c5, carry restored:true and reset sequence to 1. Direct source probe confirms restoration triggers a wake, while viewer-opened does not. Restore/reload should retain the window without waking the idle chat.
